punchline: Success can undo itself: focus brings success, success brings options, and chasing the options dissolves the focus.
thirty_sec: Greg McKeown draws one person's energy twice. In the first sketch it sprays out as little arrows in every direction. In the second, the same energy points one way. The scattered version gets what he calls a millimeter of progress in a million directions. And the scattering often starts with success, because a win brings new options. His answer is the disciplined pursuit of less: pick fewer things, and give them everything.
question: Has a win ever brought you so many new opportunities that the thing you were good at started getting less of your time?
